reviews.comment: CHEN 433 during Spring Semester. Prof Wygle is great. Gives weekly lectures on industry experience. Lab manuals are provided. TAs and Prof do well in guiding through lab experiments. Prof is helpful with Excel calculations for better understanding of the topics. All labs require a submission of Excel calculations and individual report.

The most genuine and caring professor I've ever had in 4 years of chemical engineering. Professor Wygle is very quick to answer any questions for both in-class and out of class material. He's had industry experience and can explain how labs apply to large-scale projects. 1000% would take again if I could. He's always there to help.

CHEN 432 during Fall Semester. Prof Wygle is great. Gives weekly lectures on industry experience. Lab manuals are provided. TAs and Prof do well in guiding through lab experiments. Prof is helpful with Excel calculations for better understanding of the topics. 1st report is in group. 2nd is a group presentation. Remaining are individual reports.

Literally the easiest lab I've ever taken. Mr. Bob is so nice, and if you even pretend to try you'll probably get an A. If you need help with calculations or if you can't get data correctly during class he's always super helpful.
